## Python Version
- Use Python 3.11.
- Do not use syntax or standard-library features introduced after Python 3.11.
- Prefer Python 3.11-compatible type hints and libraries.
- Do not add `from __future__ import annotations` unless it is required by the implementation or project conventions.
- Follow existing project coding conventions.
- Do not introduce unnecessary dependencies.
- Generate tests using pytest.
- Do not modify unrelated files.
